text: "But the plan is, they cannot have a nuclear weapon, and they didn't say that in their letter," Trump says of Iran.
translated_text: “但计划是，他们不能拥有核武器，他们在信中没有这么说，”特朗普谈到伊朗时说道。

text: "I would say the ceasefire is on massive life support, where the doctor walks in and says, 'Sir, your loved one has approximately a 1% chance of living," Trump says in Oval, referring to Iran.
translated_text: “我想说的是，停火是建立在大量生命支持的基础上，医生走进来说，‘先生，你所爱的人大约有 1% 的生存机会，”特朗普在椭圆形会议上说道，指的是伊朗。

text: In 1970 men had twice the sperm count as our teenagers do today,@SecKennedysays in Oval.
translated_text: 1970 年，男性的精子数量是当今青少年的两倍，@SecKennedy 在 Oval 说道。
